title: From the Six-Trak to the Nymphes
intro: The Nymphes is a six-voice analogue polysynth from Dreadbox of Athens, released in 2021 and powered over USB. Its makers took the idea from Sequential’s Six-Trak: one oscillator and noise per voice through a filter and an amplifier, played into a reverb. They kept the simplicity and added a sub, a high-pass filter, a second LFO, six ways of sharing out the voices and a modulation matrix, all reached from fourteen sliders.

timeline.name: Sequential Circuits Six-Trak
timeline.text: A six-voice analogue polysynth with one oscillator per voice and the first multitimbral synth. Dreadbox name it as the starting point: an oscillator and noise through a filter and an amp, which with only a reverb pedal covers a wide range of sounds.

timeline.name: Dreadbox Murmux
timeline.text: Dreadbox’s first synthesizer line: a handmade analogue monosynth with two VCOs, a four-pole low-pass filter and separate filter and amp envelopes.

timeline.name: Dreadbox Abyss
timeline.text: Dreadbox’s first polysynth: four voices, each one oscillator and a sub through a four-pole low-pass filter, with built-in effects. The Nymphes keeps its one-oscillator voice.

timeline.name: Dreadbox Typhon
timeline.text: An analogue monosynth under digital control, powered over USB, with presets and digital effects: the approach the Nymphes takes to a poly.

timeline.name: Dreadbox Nymphes
timeline.text: Six analogue voices, each one oscillator morphing sawtooth to square to triangle, a sub and white noise, a 24 dB resonant low-pass and two envelopes and an LFO per voice; a 6 dB high-pass and a digital reverb on the sum, a shared LFO 2, six play modes with programmable chords, and 98 presets. No keyboard: it is played over MIDI.

relatives.name: Dreadbox Murmux Adept
relatives.text: An eight-voice Dreadbox poly with two VCOs per voice, and the Nymphes’s pairing of a 24 dB low-pass with a 6 dB high-pass.

relatives.name: Dreadbox Artemis
relatives.text: A six-voice Dreadbox desktop poly with two VCOs per voice and effects made with Sinevibes.

relatives.name: Korg minilogue xd
relatives.text: A four-voice analogue poly of the same years with voice modes that stack or chord its voices and a digital reverb. This app plays it too.

note: The Nymphes is a recent instrument, and no record is well enough documented as made on it to list here.
